data.narrative:
Salient Motion is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $12M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable in the robotics sector, spanning seed through Series B stages. Leading private peers include Humanoid, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current valuation, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $24M. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Humanoid ($1.4B, Series A), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B, Seed). The median valuation across this set is $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B.

The triangulated analysis yields a wide range: $20.4M (low), $837M (median), and $1.9B (high). The substantial dispersion reflects fundamental uncertainty about Salient Motion's competitive positioning within the peer set. Stage-progression suggests early-stage valuation; peer-median reflects the elevated multiples observed across recent robotics venture fundraising. The low-end anchors to early-stage metrics; the high-end represents peer-based ceiling assumptions. Material uncertainties include technology differentiation, commercial traction, and the timing of subsequent financing rounds within the broader robotics market.
